reserveReview.rationale: Pinned Ethereum block 26088256, timestamp 1790746727 (2026-09-30), reconciles eight registered facilitator bucket levels to 699,000,000 GHO supply. The reviewed address-book GSMs report positive getUsed plus getCurrentBacking excess: stataUSDT $18,999,688.174487 and stataUSDC $0.034709. Both are unfrozen and unseized. Same-block UNDERLYING_ASSET reads resolve the USDC module to receipt 0xd4fa2d31b7968e448877f69a96de69f5de8cd23e and the USDT module to receipt 0x7bc3485026ac48b6cf9baf0a377477fff5703af8; their asset() getters return canonical Ethereum USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 and USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. These are Aave receipt claims, not idle issuer-token custody. The adapter attributes measured claims only to their mainnet parent and retains the uncovered balance as unknown. Increased precision preserves positive USDC dust. The $291,000,311.790804 uncovered mainnet allocation cannot be resolved to further issuers from these reads.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Same-block Ethereum facilitator bucket levels, totalSupply and tracked GSM getUsed/getCurrentBacking at block 26088256; adapter-derived parent-local issuance attribution
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Mainnet residual and remote Arbitrum/Monad issuance together remain 55.93709753802633% unresolved at the constituent level. These are research surfaces, not proven issuer-specific holdings. Measured GSM holdings are linked; unmeasured submodule allocations are withheld. Issuer questionnaire pending.
